notes: Eight own pages read on mortgagetech.ice.com (the canonical home https://www.icemortgagetechnology.com/ redirects there), all HTTP 200 and not thin; the eight-page limit is reached. One cited page was read for the cause of C04 (ainora.lt, a blog, typed other). The Marketplace (marketplace.icemortgagetechnology.com) that lists integration partners was not read, so the Blend integration (C10) is unverifiable. Not coded: market share figures (about 50% of originations, 90% of residential loans touched, survey shares), named customers, review ratings, capability and compliance descriptions, implementation times, cost opinions, the Encompass compliance and KYC product from another company mentioned in q4 Google AI Overviews 2, Encompass Health, and Empower (Dark Matter Technologies) mentions that attribute Empower to another company. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser snapshots exist for ICE Mortgage Technology and no claim was unverifiable because a page was blocked or thin; a re-search of all eight own snapshots for Ellie Mae, Blend, eRegistry, Encompass Web, Encompass Digital Lending, Empower, Black Knight and an integration count settled nothing new (the about and home pages name MERS eRegistry only as a MERS service, not as Encompass support, so C12 stays unverifiable). The gap lines are capability descriptions, recommendations, named customers (Guild Mortgage, Wells Fargo), Consumer Connect's integration with Encompass itself (an ICE product, not a third-party integration) and Blend integration lines from answers that already carry a C10 instance; nothing added. The table and sub-heading scan of the full answers (q2, q5, q6 and q8 tables, the q8 Google pipe tables, the Encompass deep-dive sections) found only lines already coded (C13 prices, C14 'Pricing is complex and volume-based' in an answer already listed) or out of scope (ratings, market share, team size, implementation time).
